title: PJM Kicks Off Annual Process of Vetting Large Load Requests

meta.summary: PJM has begun its annual review of proposed Large Load adjustments to determine the impact to PJM’s 2027 Long-Term Load Forecast, using updated guidelines designed to better account for how likely proposed projects are to materialize.
